title: Indicator after adjoining the initial coordinate
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every finite set $T\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the binary indicator vector of the set consisting of the initial coordinate together with the one-place shifts of the elements of $T$ is the vector of length $n+1$ whose initial coordinate is $1$ and whose remaining coordinates are the indicator vector of $T$.
